descriptions.d24d_worm_landing_8014b498: Worm landing: reads Worm.FallDamageRatio; a hard landing plays Part_JumpCollideLarge, a ground effect and (when +652 is clear) applies fall damage through the handle record, releases +800, sets +660 and posts messages; a soft landing plays Part_JumpCollide while the counter is at most 15; then the knock sound 0x80153aac.
